description: Moves one session on the agenda of an event the person organizes to a new start time or a new room ("move the Women Founders Track to the Harbor Room", "push the keynote to 4:30 PM"). A new time and a new room are two changes, previewed one at a time. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm`: the reply is a PREVIEW with a `changeId`, the before and after of each field, how many pass holders would be notified and the exact notice, and nothing changes. Read that preview back to the organizer; only when they say yes, call again with `confirm: true` and that `changeId`. Pass holders are notified of a move by default; `notify: false` keeps it quiet. Name the session by the `sessionId` the agenda gave or by its title; if the reply says AMBIGUOUS or NO_SUCH_SESSION, read the candidates back and ask which one. Only the organizer of the event can change it; anybody else is refused, and the refusal is read out as given. It requires a personal connector token.

at.description: OPTIONAL. The session's current start ("10:30 AM"), which distinguishes sessions that share a title.

changeId.description: REQUIRED with confirm: the changeId the preview returned.

confirm.description: Leave out for the PREVIEW. Only after the organizer says yes to the preview, call again with confirm: true and the changeId.

date.description: OPTIONAL. The day, YYYY-MM-DD, when the event runs more than one day or the session moves to another day.

end.description: The new end, same forms. Left out, the session keeps its length.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event name as the organizer spells it.

notify.description: OPTIONAL. A move notifies pass holders by default; false keeps it quiet.

room.description: The room or place label, plain words.

sessionId.description: The session's id exactly as the agenda or a candidates list gave it.

sessionTitle.description: Or the session's title as the agenda spells it, when there is no sessionId.

start.description: The new start: "4:30 PM", or a full timestamp with a time zone. Read in the event's own time zone.

name: event_session_move
title: Move a session to a new time or room (organizers only)
